title: Remove cat icon, add theme-colored circle indicator, and add green to color scheme switcher

requirements.text: Update the bottom ThemeToggleBar to remove the cat image while keeping a circular indicator next to the color scheme toggle.

quotes: can you remove the cat but keep the circle

acceptanceCriteria: A circular UI element remains next to the color scheme toggle button in ThemeToggleBar.
No broken image icon or empty element is present in the ThemeToggleBar.

requirements.text: Make the circular indicator in ThemeToggleBar automatically reflect the currently selected color scheme (theme colors) so that switching color scheme updates the circle color.

quotes: keep the circle and make it change to the color of the thems

acceptanceCriteria: When the user switches the color scheme, the circle’s fill color changes accordingly without requiring a page reload.
The circle color is derived from the active theme/color-scheme CSS variables (e.g., primary/accent), not hard-coded to black.
The circle remains clearly visible in both light and dark theme modes.

requirements.text: Extend the color scheme switcher to include a Green option: update color-scheme state management, persistence, UI label(s), aria-label(s), and add corresponding CSS variable overrides for green in both light and dark modes.
acceptanceCriteria: The color scheme state supports three values: blue, purple, and green, and continues to persist via localStorage.
The UI control in ThemeToggleBar cycles through Blue, Purple, and Green and displays the correct label for the current scheme.
The document root attribute data-color-scheme updates to "green" when green is selected.

frontend/src/index.css includes a green color-scheme override for light mode (:root[data-color-scheme="green"]) and dark mode (.dark[data-color-scheme="green"]) covering primary/accent/ring (and any other scheme-specific variables currently overridden for blue).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).
Do not edit immutable hook bootstrap files listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts / .tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Keep the backend as single-actor; no backend changes are required for this request.
nonGoals: Implementing any new backend APIs or persistence beyond the existing localStorage-based theme/color-scheme settings.
Adding new authentication or account features.
Generating or modifying the existing cat image asset (it may remain in the repo even if unused).
